keyword: how signal latency affects trading bot profitability
search_intent_description: The searcher already runs a bot or is about to deploy one, and wants a concrete answer to: 'does latency actually move my P&L, by how much, and what would I need to change to fix it?' They expect real numbers (ms ranges per broker class, win-rate deltas per strategy class), a way to measure their own setup, and a decision rule for when to spend on lower-latency infra vs. when not to bother.
audience: Intermediate retail traders evaluating whether to switch from manual to automated trading; comfortable with broker APIs and MT4/5 but uncertain about latency's practical impact.
notes: Demo article scaffolded without Anthropic API. Hand-written fixtures demonstrate all 4 non-Gemini visual types (matplotlib chart, mermaid, chartjs, html block).
